verdict.rationale: AvaTax's core value prop is that jurisdiction-aware tax logic, rates, and rule changes (including temporary tax changes) are handled server-side via API calls, so ops users never need to redeploy anything — this is implicit in the SaaS/API architecture (docs-1, docs-14, docs-20) and backed by claims of 200+ country/jurisdiction coverage (docs-10). However, there's no evidence of a public changelog, release notes, or documented effective-dates process showing exactly when rate/rule updates land, which the story explicitly asks for. Missing for 10: documented update/changelog process with effective dates, independent confirmation that updates are truly automatic with no client action, and evidence of update cadence/notification to customers.
